title: Blue Pearl at Grayton
meta_description: Find the perfect Grayton Beach, FL vacation rental at “The Blue Pearl”, a luxury 6-bed, 6.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Short Distance to Grayton Beach - Six Seater Golf Cart Included - Six Adult Bikes Included Experience the epitome of coastal luxury at The Blue Pearl at Grayton, nestled in the heart of Grayton Beach. This sleek and modern beach cottage welcomes you with a beautiful stone paver entry, setting the tone for the opulence that awaits within. As you step inside, be mesmerized by the light and airy ambiance created by the floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the beach. Custom light fixtures add a touch of elegance to every corner, illuminating the space with a warm glow. The first floor of this exquisite retreat boasts a spacious living room, perfect for gatherings and relaxation. The gorgeous chef’s kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring a large island with extra seating where you can enjoy casual meals or entertain guests in style. The first floor also hosts two king bedrooms, each with a private bathroom. One of these bedrooms offers a luxurious retreat with a shower and a soaking tub, while the other features a convenient shower. The living room seamlessly flows into the kitchen and dining area, creating a harmonious space for socializing. Additionally, The Blue Pearl at Grayton pampers you with a luxurious laundry room adorned with a brass sink and fixtures, providing ample space for folding and storage. Venture upstairs to discover the second floor, where indulgence continues. Two more king bedrooms await, each with its private bath featuring a shower. One of these bedrooms also boasts a rejuvenating soaking tub, offering a serene escape after a day of beach activities. A queen bedroom with a shower-tub combo provides comfort and convenience, while a bunk room with two twin-over-queen beds and a private bathroom with a shower is perfect for younger guests or additional visitors. An additional large laundry room with abundant storage ensures that your stay is as convenient as it is lavish. The thoughtfully designed interiors are complemented by luxurious outdoor amenities. Step onto the outside deck to experience the warmth of the modern firepit, ideal for cozy evenings under the stars. The private pool oasis beckons with its inviting waters and a captivating fire feature, creating an enchanting ambiance for relaxation and entertainment. For al fresco dining, the outside dining area with a built-in fire feature sets the stage for memorable meals with loved ones, surrounded by the beauty of Grayton Beach. Experience a seamless blend of comfort, style, and sophistication at The Blue Pearl at Grayton, where every detail is crafted to elevate your coastal getaway into a luxurious retreat.
